task: Run the advanced-data source-free provider graph under opt-in ABI-v10.
observation: The existing 14-provider harness accepted --abi v10 and built provider artifacts, but decoded the entire .mossi file as UTF-8 to inspect its ABI. ABI-v10 appends a binary_contract section, so this check raised UnicodeDecodeError before the consumer ran. Reading only the text header before binary_contract fixed the harness; ABI-v10 Debug and Release then passed.
impact: A harness-format assumption obscured the actual source-free consumer result. The boundary-aware header check now lets the same 14-provider gate validate both ABI families.
evidence: UnicodeDecodeError at .mossi header inspection before fix

resolution.summary: The checker reads only the textual .mossi header before binary_contract. The source-free consumer success marker is ABI-neutral; rerun passed ABI-v10 Debug and Release.

tool_used: Margo provider builds, Moss source-free consumer checks, and the ABI-v10 artifact reader
